title: Fourier coefficients of the noise operator
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\rho$ be real, let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and let $S$ be a set of coordinates. The Fourier coefficient at $S$ of the noise operator applied to $f$ is $\rho^{|S|}\widehat f(S)$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is real-valued on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
$S$ is a subset of the coordinate set
